What's new in Vekrun 0.4.8 — Back, one step at a time

• A Back button at the left of the top bar (also ⌘[ and your mouse's back button). If you went deeper on a page — into a folder of the architecture map, or an open error in Production monitoring — Back steps out of that first, then returns to the page you came from. It always says where it will take you.
• Engineering Memory's Impact now explains its warnings: "What could break, and what Vekrun can't see" says what the risks are and where Vekrun's map of the code can't follow, so the lists below may miss something.
